digest.component_or_area: LLM gateway observability and request header configuration
propositions: Operators cannot currently correlate LLM gateway calls to rebar gate runs because rebar sends no request metadata, leaving trace_id hardcoded to None despite the schema reserving it

Configurable request headers with environment variable (${env:...}) and per-run value (${run:...}) substitution must be delivered through pydantic-ai ModelSettings.extra_headers without vendor-specific header names in shipped code
All LLM calls within one gate run must carry the same correlation value read from active OpenTelemetry span or newly minted, with the value placed in the verdict trace_id field

Credential-bearing headers (authorization, x-api-key, cookie, host, proxy-authorization) and values containing CR/LF/NUL must be rejected at config resolution; headers with absent ${run:...} substituends must be omitted rather than sent empty
Headers must never appear in logs, diagnostics, or provider_provenance records to prevent credential leakage
Operator-facing documentation must record the config key, substitution grammar, rejected header names, and recipes for at least two distinct gateways without implying vendor preference
